KeepKeys clones the source and retains only the requested keys.
Missing and repeated keys are ignored.

return.description: Independent map containing only selected keys.

signatures.description:
Keys returns an independent list of map keys in unspecified order.
Use sorted(object::keys(value)) when ordering is required.

return.description: Independent list of keys in unspecified order.

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: Variadic maps, or one list of maps.

signatures.description:
Merge copies maps into an independent destination; later values replace earlier values.
Successful factory construction transfers destination ownership to this call.
Population failure closes a closable destination and joins cleanup errors;
success transfers the result to the caller. Source maps remain borrowed.

return.description: Shallow merge with cloned or copied values.

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: Variadic maps, or one list of maps.

signatures.description:
MergeDeep copies maps into an independent destination, merging nested maps recursively.
Arrays, scalars, and none are replaced by later values.
After successful factory construction, population failure closes a closable
destination and joins cleanup errors. Successful results transfer to the caller;
source maps remain borrowed. Failed construction is the factory's responsibility.

return.description: Deep merge with cloned or copied values.

parameters.name: keys
parameters.description: Variadic keys, or one list of keys; an empty list omits nothing.

signatures.description:
OmitKeys clones the source and removes the requested keys.
Missing and repeated keys are ignored.

return.description: Independent map without selected keys.

signatures.description: Values returns cloned or copied map values in unspecified order.

return.description: Independent list of values, following each value's clone or copy contract.

signatures.description:
Zip constructs an object from parallel key and value lists of equal length.
Keys must be strings. Duplicate keys use the last value in the input.

return.description: Independent object containing cloned or copied values.

parameters.name: keys
parameters.description: Variadic keys, or one list of keys; an empty list keeps nothing.

signatures.description:
KeepKeysMutable removes unselected keys from the original target and returns it.
Retained values are untouched. Missing and repeated keys are ignored; errors
may leave earlier removals applied.

return.description: The original target containing only selected keys.

parameters.name: sources
parameters.description: Zero or more maps, or one list of maps.

signatures.description:
MergeMutable merges sources into the original target and returns that same map.
Incoming values are cloned or copied; later sources win. Errors may leave
earlier updates applied. A target without sources is returned unchanged.

return.description: The original mutated target.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Map to mutate; its top-level aliases observe changes.

parameters.name: sources
parameters.description: Zero or more maps, or one list of maps.

signatures.description:
MergeDeepMutable deep merges sources into the original target, returning it.
Conflicting nested maps are cloned before modification so external nested
aliases remain unchanged. Arrays, scalars, and none are replaced. Errors may
leave earlier updates applied. A target without sources is returned unchanged.

return.description: The original target with independently merged nested branches.

parameters.name: keys
parameters.description: Variadic keys, or one list of keys; an empty list omits nothing.

signatures.description:
OmitKeysMutable removes selected keys from the original target and returns it.
Retained values are untouched. Missing and repeated keys are ignored; errors
may leave earlier removals applied.

return.description: The original target without selected keys.

signatures.description:
choice selects one uniformly distributed value using the Session's pseudo-random source.

return.description: One original value, or None for an empty list. Empty and singleton lists consume no randomness.

throws.description: The argument is not a List.

signatures.description: float draws a non-cryptographic pseudo-random number from the Session source.

return.description: A number in the half-open interval [0, 1).

parameters.name: min
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound; must be finite and not exceed max.

parameters.name: max
parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound; must be finite.

signatures.description: float draws a non-cryptographic pseudo-random number between finite bounds.

return.description: A number in [min, max), or Float(min) for equal bounds without drawing. Original numeric bounds are preserved for unequal intervals.

throws.description: A bound is not a native Int or Float.
Bounds are non-finite, reversed, or unequal with no representable Float in the interval.

parameters.name: min
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound; must not exceed max. Floats are not coerced.

parameters.name: max
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound, including the maximum supported Int.

signatures.description: int draws a non-cryptographic pseudo-random integer between inclusive bounds.

return.description: A uniformly distributed integer in [min, max]. Equal bounds return min without drawing.

throws.description: A bound is not an Int.
The minimum exceeds the maximum.

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: Input list, traversed once and never modified. Its factory creates the destination; values retain their identity.

signatures.description:
shuffle randomizes the input values using the Session's pseudo-random source.
Materialization and Fisher-Yates use O(n) append/swap operations; their cost
and the destination's storage depend on the source's collection backend.

return.description: A new list preserving the source's implementation family and backend configuration, containing the original values in randomized order. Empty and singleton lists consume no randomness.

throws.description: The argument is not a List.
